scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
你为什么携带这么多物品？
你是在参加什么训练课程吗？

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Lu~lu~lu~lu~
Lu~ Huh?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
卢~卢~卢~卢~
卢~ 嗯？

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Wow, you must be a beginner, right?
What an innocent face! Ha~ hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
哇，你一定是个新手吧？
多么天真的脸啊！哈~ 哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Why don't you do some hunting outside instead of walking around and wasting your time?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
与其四处闲逛浪费时间，不如去外面打猎呢。

scripts.text: I am about to leave now.
scripts.translation: 我正要离开。

scripts.text: I've got a Hunting Mission.
scripts.translation: 我有一个打猎任务。

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Oh, well. Then, go figure.
Bye~ bye.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
哦，好吧。那就随你吧。
再见~

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
What mission do you have?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
哦，你是乐园团的？
你有什么任务？

scripts.text: Hunting Poison Spore
scripts.translation: 狩猎毒魔菇

scripts.text: Hunting Smokie
scripts.translation: 狩猎狸猫

scripts.text: Hunting Elder Willow
scripts.translation: 讨伐长老树精

scripts.text: Hunting Coco
scripts.translation: 讨伐可可

scripts.text: Hunting Thara Frog
scripts.translation: 讨伐达拉蛙

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
{0}!
Wow, I didn't expect you would do that mission. I was just about to give up. But you did good job. I appreciate it!
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
{0}！
哇，没想到你会做那个任务。我本来都要放弃了。但你做得很好，非常感谢！

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Well, I requested the mission and you did an excellent job.
I will give you a reward as I promised.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
嗯，我发布了任务，而你出色地完成了它。
我会兑现承诺，给你奖励。

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Here it is. Thank you very much. God bless you!
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
给你。非常感谢。愿上帝保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Oh, you are right.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
哦，你说得对。

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
But, you haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come to me now? You haven't completed the mission!
I will give you a reward if you complete the mission. Ok? Are we good?
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
但是，你还没有完成任务。为什么现在来找我？你还没完成呢！
等你完成任务后，我会给你奖励的。好吗？我们说定了？

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Anyway, I will be here waiting for you. Please come back when you finish the mission!
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
总之，我会在这里等你。完成任务后请回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
咦？你确定吗？哪里不对劲...

scripts.text:
[Sponiac]
It is weird.
Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[斯波尼亚克]
这很奇怪。
请按 'alt + u' 键检查你的任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
你为什么带着这么多物品？
你是在参加什么训练课程吗？

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Hu hu~~ we are delivery men~
We are faster than any flight~!
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
呼呼~~ 我们是快递员~
我们比任何飞行都更快~！

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Welcome~ welcome!
We are the fastest delivery company, Dieshin Corperation.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
欢迎~ 欢迎！
我们是速度最快的快递公司，迪辛公司。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I don't need help.
scripts.translation: 我不需要帮助。

scripts.text: I've got a Delivery Mission.
scripts.translation: 我有一个送货任务。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Oh, well. Then, go figure. Bye~!
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
哦，好吧。那就随你吧。再见~！

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
What mission do you have?
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
哦，你是乐园团的吗？
有什么任务需要处理？

scripts.text: Deliver an Insecticide.
scripts.translation: 送杀虫剂

scripts.text: Deliver Honey.
scripts.translation: 送蜂蜜

scripts.text: Deliver Blankets.
scripts.translation: 送毯子

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
咦？你确定吗？好像有点不对劲...

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
It is weird.
Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
这很奇怪。
请按 'alt + u' 检查你的任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Wait, but you already have a delivery box.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
等等，你手里已经有一个送货的木箱子了。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
We can't allow you to deliver two boxes at once. So, please finish your delivery first.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
我们不能让你一次送两个箱子。所以，请先完成你当前的送货任务。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
If you forgot where to deliver, then please check Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
如果你忘了送到哪里，请按 'alt + u' 检查任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Ah ha! I got it!
The insecticide? It must be the Zoologist on the southeast of Payon who ordered the Insecticide.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
啊哈！我想起来了！
杀虫剂？应该是斐扬东南方的动物学家订购的杀虫剂。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Ah ha! I got it!
Honey? It must be the Entomologist at the west of St. Capitolina Abbey, wich is northeast of Prontera who ordered the Honey.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
啊哈！我想起来了！
蜂蜜？应该是普隆德拉东北方圣卡普蒂娜修道院西边的昆虫学家订购的蜂蜜。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Oh, Right!
The blankets! It must be the biologist in the south of Lutie field who ordered the blankets.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
哦，对了！
毯子！应该是姜饼城野外南方的生物学家订购的毯子。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
You can can go to Lutie by asking Mr. Claus in the northeastern part of Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
你可以去找艾尔帕兰东北方的克劳斯先生，让他带你去姜饼城。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
Dieshin's cooperation motive is to give the fastest and credited delivery. So please deliver it now without any delay.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
迪辛公司的宗旨是提供最快速、最可靠的配送服务。所以请立刻送货，不要延误。

scripts.text:
[Dieshin Man]
If you forgot where to make the delivery, then please check the Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[迪辛的男子]
如果你忘了送到哪里，请按 'alt + u' 检查任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
你为什么带着这么多东西？
是在参加什么训练课程吗？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Have you heard of a monster named Bigfoot?
It looks like a bear with red fur and has a 'X' shape scar on his shoulder.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
你听说过叫做大脚怪的魔物吗？
它看起来像一头红毛熊，肩膀上有一个“X”形的伤疤。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
According to the recent research, flies and Bigfoot monsters have a symbiotic relationship.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
根据最近的研究，苍蝇和大脚怪之间存在共生关系。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I am currently studying about it and try to prove the theory. So I plan to kill the flies around Bigfoot and observe his reaction.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
我正在研究这个，并试图证明这个理论。所以我打算杀死大脚怪周围的苍蝇，观察它的反应。

scripts.text: ...I am not interested.
scripts.translation: ...我不感兴趣。

scripts.text: Here is the Insecticide.
scripts.translation: 这是杀虫剂。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Oh, I need an Insecticide to continue the study.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
哦，我需要杀虫剂才能继续研究。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Huh?
You are not Dieshin's delivery man?
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
咦？
你不是迪辛的送货员吗？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I am waiting for a special delivery.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
我在等一个特别的快递。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Oh ho! Yes! That one!
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
哦！对对对！就是这个！

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
That is the Insecticide that I ordered! You were sent by Dieshin right?
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
这就是我订购的杀虫剂！你是迪辛派来的吧？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I have been waiting for this!
Give it to me!
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
我等了很久了！
快给我！

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
It arrived much faster than I thought. I want to test it right away!
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
比我想的快多了。我想马上测试一下！

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Well done. Good Job! Thank you so much! Here is a little gift for you.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
干得好。谢谢你的帮助！这是给你的小礼物。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
I appreciate your kindness.
But, what did you bring?
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
谢谢你的好意。
不过，你带了什么来？

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Hmm, I thought that Dieshin was fast and accurate, but you brought me an empty box. How disappointing.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
嗯，我以为迪辛又快又准，结果你给我带了个空盒子。真让人失望。

scripts.text:
[Zoologist]
Please bring my order. Dieshin will give you my product.
scripts.translation:
[动物学家]
请把我的订单带来。迪辛会给你我的产品。

scripts.translation:

它长得像昆虫，皮肤黑亮，头上有一根巨大的角。

scripts.text:
[Entomologist]
Recent research came out and showed that this monster can be tamed and trained by Honey.
scripts.translation:

最近的研究表明，这种魔物可以用蜂蜜驯服和训练。

scripts.text:
[Entomologist]
I am currently studying about it and trying to prove the theory. So I plan to set a Honey trap on the places he usually passes and observe his reaction.
scripts.translation:
[昆虫学家]
我正在研究这个，并试图证明这个理论。所以我打算在它经常经过的地方设置蜂蜜陷阱，观察它的反应。

scripts.text: ...I am not interested.
scripts.translation: ...我不感兴趣。

scripts.text: Here is the Honey.

scripts.translation:
[生物学家]
你听说过冰波利这种魔物吗？

scripts.text:
[Biologist]
Porings steal items if they see them on the ground. However, Marin has no interest in dropped items. So I was wondering, how come Marin doesn't pay attention to gathering items even though they are the same kind of monster as Porings.
scripts.translation:
[生物学家]
波利看到地上的物品会偷走它们。然而，冰波利对掉落物品毫无兴趣。所以我很想知道，既然冰波利和波利是同一种类的魔物，为什么冰波利不关注收集物品呢。

scripts.text:
[Biologist]
But, this place is freaking cold.
scripts.translation:
[生物学家]
但是，这里冷得要命。

scripts.text: ...I am not interested.
scripts.translation: ...我不感兴趣。

scripts.text: Here are the blankets.

请把我的订单带过来。迪辛会把我的产品交给你。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Why are you carrying so many items?
Are you in a training course or something?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你为什么带着这么多东西？
是在参加什么训练课程吗？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Here is some hair~ a broken clock~!
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
这里有一些头发~ 还有一个坏掉的钟~！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Broken clock..? Hu hu..
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
坏掉的钟..？呼呼..

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Hey~! Dude! You look like a very rich adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
嘿~！伙计！你看起来像个很有钱的冒险者。

scripts.text: I am a poor adventurer.
scripts.translation: 我是个贫穷的冒险者。

scripts.text: I have a gathering mission.
scripts.translation: 我有一个采集任务。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Really? Hmm, oh right. You don't look sophisticated.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
真的吗？嗯，对了。你看起来并不富裕。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You are a poor adventurer~! Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你是个贫穷的冒险者~！祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Oh, you are from the Eden Group?
What mission do you have?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
哦，你是乐园团的？
你有什么任务？

scripts.text: Gather Bones
scripts.translation: 采集骨头

scripts.text: Gather Animal Skin
scripts.translation: 采集动物外皮

scripts.text: Gather Peelings
scripts.translation: 采集果皮

scripts.text: Gather Tails
scripts.translation: 采集尾巴

scripts.text: Gather Cookies
scripts.translation: 采集绿饼人

scripts.text: Gather Mustaches
scripts.translation: 采集胡子

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Skel-Bones?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
我看你有采集任务。
但是，骷髅骨在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你还没做任务呢。为什么又回到这里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You don't have enough 'Skel-Bones'... You can find it when you hunt Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你的“骷髅骨”不够... 打邪骸战士可以掉落。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
To find Skeletons, you better check Payon Dungeon 1F, which is located in Archer Village, north of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
想要找邪骸战士，建议去斐扬北边的弓箭手村，那里有一楼斐扬地下城。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where is the Bear's Footskins and Animal Skins?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
我看你有采集任务。
但是，熊掌和动物外皮在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你还没做任务呢。为什么又回到这里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You have to bring 10 Bear's Footskins' and '5 Animal Skins!
You can find Bear's Footskin from Bigfoot and Animal Skin from Animals.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你需要带10个熊掌和5个动物外皮来完成这个任务。
大脚怪会掉落熊掌，动物会掉落动物外皮。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Bigfoot is around the north of Geffen field or the southeast of Payon field.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
大脚怪在吉芬野外北部或斐扬野外东南部附近。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Worm Peelings and Garlets?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
我看你有采集任务。
但是，虫皮和加勒结晶在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You have to bring '20 Worm Peelings' and '20 Garlets' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你需要带20个虫皮和20个加勒结晶来完成这个任务。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get those items from 'Piere', 'Andre', 'Deniro', 'Vitata', 'Thief Bug', 'Female Thief Bug' and 'Male Thief Bug'.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你可以从工蚁、白蚁、兵蚁、黑蚁、浮勒盗虫、雌性浮勒盗虫和雄性浮勒盗虫身上获得这些物品。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
'Piere', 'Andre', 'Deniro' and 'Vitata' are in Ant Hell which is located near the Saint Darmain Fortress soutwest of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
工蚁、白蚁、兵蚁和黑蚁在蚂蚁地狱，位于摩洛克西南方的圣达姆安要塞附近。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
'Thief Bug', 'Female Thief Bug' and 'Male Thief Bug' are int he Prontere Culvert. To get there, you need to be a volunteer of the Prontera Culvert's punitive force.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
浮勒盗虫、雌性浮勒盗虫和雄性浮勒盗虫在普隆德拉下水道。要到达那里，你需要成为普隆德拉下水道惩罚部队的志愿者。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Yoyo Tails, Acorns and Raccoon Leafs?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
我看你有采集任务。
但是，溜溜猴尾巴、橡果和变身叶子在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '10 Yoyo Tails,' '10 Acorns' and '10 Raccoon Leafs' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你还没做任务呢。为什么又回到这里？
你需要带10个溜溜猴尾巴、10个橡果和10个变身叶子来完成这个任务。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get Yoyo Tails from 'Yoyo's', Acorn from 'Coco's' and Raccoon Leaf from 'Smokies'.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
溜溜猴尾巴可以从溜溜猴身上获得，橡果可以从可可身上获得，变身叶子可以从狸猫身上获得。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can find them easily around fields, but the field east of Ayothaya is the best spot for hunting all 3 monsters.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
在野外很容易找到它们，但哎哟泰雅东边的野外是打这三种魔物最好的地方。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
To get to Ayothaya, you better go to 'Aibakthing' in Alberta and pay his fare.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
要去哎哟泰雅，最好去艾尔贝塔找艾巴克辛并支付车费。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Well-baked Cookies and the Piece of Cake?
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
我看你有采集任务。
但是，姜饼和小蛋糕在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '5 Well-baked Cookies' and '1 Piece of Cake' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你还没做任务呢。为什么又回到这里？
你需要带5个姜饼和1个小蛋糕来完成这个任务。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get Well-baked Cookie from 'Cookies' who wears red or green shirts.
For getting Piece of Cake, you should look for 'Mystcases'.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
姜饼可以从穿红衣服或绿衣服的绿饼人身上获得。
要获得小蛋糕，你应该去找神秘箱。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Both monsters canbe found in the Toy Factory Warehouse or Toy Monitoring Room. To get there, ask Mr. Claus in the northeastern part of Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
这两种魔物都可以在玩具工厂仓库或玩具分类场找到。要到达那里，请去艾尔帕兰东北部的克劳斯先生那里询问。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
I can see that you have a gathering mission.
But, where are the Mole Whiskerss and Mole Claws??
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
我看你有采集任务。
但是，鼠须和鼠指甲在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You haven't done the mission yet. Why did you come back here?
You have to bring '5 Mole Whiskers' and '3 Mole Claws' to complete the mission.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你还没做任务呢。为什么又回到这里？
你需要带5个鼠须和3个鼠指甲来完成这个任务。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
You can get those items from 'Martins'.
Martins can be found in the Mjolnir Dead Pit, but the second floor is dangerous, so be careful!
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
你可以从土拨鼠身上获得这些物品。
土拨鼠可以在妙勒尼尔死亡之坑找到，但第二层很危险，请小心！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
To get there, ask a Kafra Employee in Geffen, they can warp you there.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
要到达那里，请去吉芬找卡普拉 职员，他们可以传送你过去。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Anyway, I will be here waiting for you. Please come back when you finish the mission!
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
总之，我会在这里等你。完成任务后请回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Huh? Are you sure? Something is wrong...
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
咦？你确定吗？好像哪里不对劲...

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
It is weird.
Please check your Quest Window by pressing 'alt + u'.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
这很奇怪。
请按'alt + u'检查你的任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Wow~ you did an excellent job!
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
哇~ 你做得太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Thank you very much. God bless you!
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
非常感谢。愿上帝保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Dashia]
Ha~! Ha~!
I will give you a reward as promised.
scripts.translation:
[达西亚]
哈~！哈~！
我会按承诺给你奖励。
